summary.tldr: Sets rules and powers for the Health Minister to help implement national pharmacare, including payments for some prescription drugs and planning for bulk buying.
what_it_does: Sets out principles the Health Minister must consider when working toward national universal pharmacare.
Gives the minister power to make payments, in some cases, for coverage of certain prescription drugs and related products.
Requires the minister to prepare a list to help develop a national formulary, which is a national list of covered drugs.
Requires the minister to develop a national bulk purchasing strategy for prescription drugs and related products.
Requires the minister to publish a pan-Canadian strategy on the appropriate use of prescription drugs and related products.
Creates a committee of experts to make recommendations.
summary.background: The bill is about working toward the implementation of national universal pharmacare. It was introduced on 29 February 2024 and given first reading in the House of Commons.
